name: Ascension: The Gods Walk This Earth
source:
A normal man in a world where the ancient gods have returned to the earth, you find yourself dragged under the wing of the god of the sun, Apollo, after you seemingly fail to "seduce" Aphrodite. Seeing your hopeless "girl catching skills", Apollo "benevolently" decides to lend you a hand(whether you want to our not) and you're set on the path to become not just any lady killer, a godly lady killer!

"Ascension" will follow a open world formula where the player is free to -attempt- to "conquer" any of the available heroines! Although it is worth noting that sometimes proper preparation is necessary in order to win the hearts of certain maidens. The gods can be very difficult at times after all. 

And whether you are in it for the deep relationship or the "fun", you are free to focus on a single god or go with the flow!
translation:
在古老诸神重返人间的世界中，你原本只是个普通男人。似乎是因为“勾引”阿佛洛狄忒失败，太阳神阿波罗将你收到了羽翼之下。见识了你无可救药的“追女孩技巧”后，他“好心”决定帮你一把，不管你愿不愿意。于是，你踏上了一条新道路，要成为拥有神级魅力的少女杀手！

《Ascension》采用开放世界形式，玩家可以自由尝试“攻略”任何可追求的女主角。不过，若想赢得某些女性的芳心，事先做好准备仍然十分重要。毕竟，诸神有时可相当难以应付。

无论你追求的是深厚的感情，还是单纯的“乐趣”，都可以专注于一位神祇，也可以顺其自然！
